nodes.name: Lemma A.1
nodes.statement:
For any
$\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\widehat \beta}^{\ensuremath{\lambda}}}, \ensuremath{\tilde\beta^{\ensuremath{\lambda}}}  \in \mathop{\mathrm{arg\,min}}_{\beta\in\mathbb{R}^p} \big\{g(\,\ensuremath{\!|\!| \textcolor{black}{\ensuremath{Y}}-\textcolor{black}{\ensuremath{X}}\beta | \! |_{2}}^{2})+\sum_{j=1}^{\ensuremath{k}}\lambda_j\,\ensuremath{\!|\!| \ensuremath{M}_j\beta | \! |_{q_j}}\big\}$ and $\alpha \in [0,1],$  it holds that $\textcolor{black}{\ensuremath{X}}\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\widehat \beta}^{\ensuremath{\lambda}}}=\textcolor{black}{\ensuremath{X}} \ensuremath{\tilde\beta^{\ensuremath{\lambda}}}$ and
equation*
\alpha\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\widehat \beta}^{\ensuremath{\lambda}}}+(1-\alpha)\ensuremath{\tilde\beta^{\ensuremath{\lambda}}} \in \mathop{\mathrm{arg\,min}}_{\beta\in\mathbb{R}^p} \big\{g(\,\ensuremath{\!|\!| \textcolor{black}{\ensuremath{Y}}-\textcolor{black}{\ensuremath{X}}\beta | \! |_{2}}^{2})+\sum_{j=1}^{\ensuremath{k}}\lambda_j\,\ensuremath{\!|\!| \ensuremath{M}_j\beta | \! |_{q_j}}\big\}\,.
equation*

nodes.name: Lemma A.2
nodes.statement:
Let $\mathbb{R}^{\ensuremath{k}}$ be  equipped with the Euclidean norm, and $\mathbb{R}$ be equipped with the  absolute value norm. Then, the function
align*
(0,\infty)^{\ensuremath{k}} &\to \mathbb{R}\\
  \lambda&\mapsto g(\,\ensuremath{\!|\!| \textcolor{black}{\ensuremath{Y}}-\textcolor{black}{\ensuremath{X}}\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\widehat \beta}^{\ensuremath{\lambda}}} | \! |_{2}}^{2})
align*
and the function
align*
(0,\infty)^{\ensuremath{k}} &\to \mathbb{R}\\
  \lambda&\mapsto \ensuremath{\!|\!| \textcolor{black}{\ensuremath{Y}}-\textcolor{black}{\ensuremath{X}}\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\widehat \beta}^{\ensuremath{\lambda}}} | \! |_{2}}^{2}
align*
are both continuous.

nodes.name: Lemma A.3
nodes.statement: With probability one, it holds that $\,\ensuremath{\!|\!| \textcolor{black}{\ensuremath{Y}}-\textcolor{black}{\ensuremath{X}}\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\widehat \beta}^{\ensuremath{\lambda}}} | \! |_{2}}^2>0$ and $g'(\,\ensuremath{\!|\!| \textcolor{black}{\ensuremath{Y}}-\textcolor{black}{\ensuremath{X}}\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\widehat \beta}^{\ensuremath{\lambda}}} | \! |_{2}}^2)> 0$ for any tuning parameter $\lambda\in(0,\infty)^{\ensuremath{k}}$.

nodes.name: Lemma 2.1
nodes.statement:
Consider fixed constants $\textcolor{black}{\ensuremath{c}}_1,\dots,\textcolor{black}{\ensuremath{c}}_{\ensuremath{k}}\in(0,\infty)$. With probability one, there is a tuning parameter $\ensuremath{\lambda}\equiv\ensuremath{\lambda}(\textcolor{black}{\ensuremath{c}}_1,\dots,\textcolor{black}{\ensuremath{c}}_{\ensuremath{k}})\in (0,\infty)^{\ensuremath{k}}$ such that
equation*
\frac{\ensuremath{\lambda}}{2g'(\,\ensuremath{\!|\!| \textcolor{black}{\ensuremath{Y}}-\textcolor{black}{\ensuremath{X}}\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\widehat \beta}^{\ensuremath{\lambda}}} | \! |_{2}}^2)}=\left(\textcolor{black}{\ensuremath{c}}_1\,\ensuremath{\!|\!| (\textcolor{black}{\ensuremath{X}}  P_1\ensuremath{M}_1^{+})^\top \textcolor{black}{\ensuremath{\varepsilon}} | \! |}_{q_1}^*,\dots,\textcolor{black}{\ensuremath{c}}_{\ensuremath{k}}\,\ensuremath{\!|\!| (\textcolor{black}{\ensuremath{X}}  P_{\ensuremath{k}}\ensuremath{M}_{\ensuremath{k}}^{+})^\top \textcolor{black}{\ensuremath{\varepsilon}} | \! |}_{q_{\ensuremath{k}}}^*\right)^\top.
equation*

nodes.name: Theorem 2.1
nodes.statement:
For any choice of $\textcolor{black}{\ensuremath{c}}_1,\dots,\textcolor{black}{\ensuremath{c}}_{\ensuremath{k}}\in(0,\infty)$, with probability one, the estimator~$\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\widehat \beta}^{\ensuremath{\lambda}}}$ defined by~(2) with tuning parameter $\ensuremath{\lambda}$ as in Lemma~2.1 above satisfies the prediction bound
 multline*
\frac{1}{n}\,\ensuremath{\!|\!| \textcolor{black}{\ensuremath{X}}(\beta^*-\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\widehat \beta}^{\ensuremath{\lambda}}}) | \! |_{2}}^2\le\inf_{\substack{\textcolor{black}{\ensuremath{u}}\in(0,1)\\\textcolor{black}{\beta}\in\mathbb{R}^p}} \Big\{\frac{1}{4\textcolor{black}{\ensuremath{u}}(1-\textcolor{black}{\ensuremath{u}})n}\,\ensuremath{\!|\!| \textcolor{black}{\ensuremath{X}}(\beta^*-\textcolor{black}{\beta}) | \! |_{2}}^2\\+\frac{1}{n}\sum_{j=1}^{\ensuremath{k}}\frac{1+\textcolor{black}{\ensuremath{c}}_j}{1-\textcolor{black}{\ensuremath{u}}}\,  \ensuremath{\!|\!| (\textcolor{black}{\ensuremath{X}}  P_j\ensuremath{M}_j^{+})^\top\textcolor{black}{\ensuremath{\varepsilon}} | \! |_{q_j}^*}  \, \ensuremath{\!|\!| \ensuremath{M}_j \textcolor{black}{\beta} | \! |_{q_j}}- \frac{1}{n}\sum_{j=1}^{\ensuremath{k}}\frac{\textcolor{black}{\ensuremath{c}}_j-1}{1-\textcolor{black}{\ensuremath{u}}}\, \ensuremath{\!|\!| (\textcolor{black}{\ensuremath{X}}  P_j\ensuremath{M}_j^{+})^\top\textcolor{black}{\ensuremath{\varepsilon}} | \! |_{q_j}^*} \,  \ensuremath{\!|\!| \ensuremath{M}_j \ensuremath{\ensuremath{\widehat \beta}^{\ensuremath{\lambda}}} | \! |_{q_j}}\Big\}\,.
multline*
